text: Pull over immediately to the right shoulder safely.
outcome_text: Correct. Virginia law requires compliance with signaling emergency vehicles.

text: Accelerate to find a more brightly lit area down the road.
outcome_text: Incorrect. Failing to pull over promptly can be interpreted as eluding.

text: Clearly state: I am remaining silent and exercising my 5th Amendment right.
outcome_text: Correct. The Supreme Court requires an explicit statement to invoke silence.

text: Say nothing at all and stare blankly at the officer.
outcome_text: Incorrect. Berghuis v. Thompkins established that remaining completely passive does not invoke your rights.
